paragraphs: The webinar drew 133 registrants and 74 attendees (55.6% attendance), yielding 31 post‑event engaged contacts, 12 MQL+ and 9 SQL+ (16.2% attendee‑to‑MQL conversion). Five accounts show buying‑committee coverage, led by Palmetto SaaS Group with a 201.5 score, 9 engaged contacts and 90% committee coverage, followed by Anchorpoint SaaS (107 score, 7 contacts, 87.5% coverage) and Truenorth Ecommerce (83.5 score, 4 contacts, 100% coverage).

Anomaly 1: a contact (company not disclosed) generated 21 of 26 touches on 2026‑08‑07 (80.8% of activity) yet the lifecycle stage never advanced, flagging a stalled hot lead that warrants a manual RevOps review. Anomaly 2: another contact (company not disclosed) produced 17 of 27 touches on 2026‑07‑25 (63.0% of activity) and the lifecycle stage already reflects the engagement, so no immediate action is required.
